poses.caption: Lie with knees bent, feet flat and a resistance loop above your knees. Keep your head and shoulders on the mat.
Press through your heels and raise your hips until shoulders, hips and knees align. Keep knees aligned with your feet; pause and lower slowly.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical illustration canonical1408 BAND HIP LIFT. TWO equal square cells side by side wide2:1. Same full body person SIDE rear-three-quarter view head LEFT feet RIGHT, same camera scale. Supine on thin gray mat, short cropped hair lets back of SKULL visibly rest on mat both poses. Head shoulders BOTH upper arms forearms palms down relaxed on mat throughout. Feet hip width soles FLAT heels planted unchanged, knees bent. Continuous thick gray resistance LOOP band around BOTH lower thighs just ABOVE knees on top of intact shorts, never across kneecaps or below knees. Knees aligned feet maintain band outward tension no collapse. LEFT START pelvis/butt grounded mat, knees bent. RIGHT FINISH lift pelvis into GLUTE BRIDGE forming straight line shoulders HIPS knees, shins roughly vertical, no lumbar overarch no head lift. Both feet remain flat same position and band same thigh location. Primary GLUTES only diffuse RED educational tint over intact shorts BACK/SEAT upper outer buttocks. Fabric remains smooth opaque with broad cloth folds, no exposed glute anatomy or fibers/segmentation through cloth. Other muscle regions grayscale. Fine detailed grayscale exposed limb anatomy realistic fingers proportions. Full opaque BLACK athletic tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK and BLACK shorts to just above knees cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH with seams normal broad folds continuous hems. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins head hands feet band mat all inside EACH cell no crop. Equal male/female detail quality. Reference original project rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup/chest red. No text labels arrows extra people.
